## Invites

- [Create Invite](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/invites/create.md): Invite a user to join the organization by email.
- [Delete Invite](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/invites/delete.md): Delete a pending invite.
- [Get Invite](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/invites/retrieve.md): Retrieve an invite by ID.
- [List Invites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/invites/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
